paper.title: Workshop on Emerging Trends in Web Advertising
paper.abstract: The landscape of web advertising is undergoing a profound transformation, fuelled by advancements in emerging technologies and innovative methodologies that prioritise user privacy, AI-driven personalisation, and immersive experiences. As the digital advertising ecosystem evolves, the exploration of these trends becomes imperative for navigating its dynamic complexities and ensuring sustainable growth. In this workshop on Emerging Topics in Web Advertising, the Web Standards Group at Samsung Research and Development Institute UK (SRUK) will create a platform for open, timely, and responsible discussions among experts from advertising, privacy, data science, and related fields, fostering the exchange of cutting-edge research and insights. This collaborative forum will delve into the latest advancements, addressing critical challenges and opportunities in the field while fostering interdisciplinary dialogue and innovation. Through this initiative, the workshop aims to shape the future of web advertising, ensuring it remains aligned with ethical standards, technological progress, and user-centric principles.
